title: Ref-1 is overexpressed in neovascular eye disease and targetable with a novel inhibitor.
authors: Muniyandi, Anbukkarasi; Hartman, Gabriella D; Sishtla, Kamakshi; Rai, Ratan; Gomes, Catia; Day, Kristina; Song, Yang; Masters, Andi R; Quinney, Sara K; Qi, Xiaoping; Woods, Hailey; Boulton, Michael E; Meyer, Jason S; Vilseck, Jonah Z; Georgiadis, Millie M; Kelley, Mark R; Corson, Timothy W
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ref-1/APE1在新生血管性眼病中的表达及小分子抑制剂APX2009的靶向治疗，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关转录因子激活，但核心为疾病治疗与湿实验验证，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模关联甚微。
abstract: Reduction-oxidation factor-1 or apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1 (Ref-1/APE1) is a crucial redox-sensitive activator of transcription factors such as NF-kappaB, HIF-1alpha, STAT-3 and others. It could contribute to key features of ocular neovascularization including inflammation and angiogenesis; these underlie diseases like neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD). We previously revealed a role for Ref-1 in the growth of ocular endothelial cells and in choroidal neovascularization (CNV). Here, we set out to further explore Ref-1 in neovascular eye disease. Ref-1 was highly expressed in human nAMD, murine laser-induced CNV and Vldlr(-/-) mouse subretinal neovascularization (SRN). Ref-1's interaction with a redox-specific small molecule inhibitor, APX2009, was shown by NMR and docking. This compound blocks crucial angiogenic features in multiple endothelial cell types. APX2009 also ameliorated murine laser-induced choroidal neovascularization (L-CNV) when delivered intravitreally. Moreover, systemic APX2009 reduced murine SRN and downregulated the expression of Ref-1 redox regulated HIF-1alpha target carbonic anhydrase 9 (CA9) in the Vldlr(-/-) mouse model. Our data validate the redox function of Ref-1 as a critical regulator of ocular angiogenesis, indicating that inhibition of Ref-1 holds therapeutic potential for treating nAMD.
abstract_zh: 还原氧化因子-1或脱嘌呤/脱嘧啶核酸内切酶1（Ref-1/APE1）是NF-kappaB、HIF-1alpha、STAT-3等转录因子的关键氧化还原敏感激活因子。它可能促进眼部新生血管形成的关键特征，包括炎症和血管生成；这些是新生血管性年龄相关性黄斑变性（nAMD）等疾病的基础。我们先前揭示了Ref-1在眼部内皮细胞生长和脉络膜新生血管形成（CNV）中的作用。在此，我们进一步探索Ref-1在新生血管性眼病中的作用。Ref-1在人类nAMD、小鼠激光诱导的CNV和Vldlr(-/-)小鼠视网膜下新生血管形成（SRN）中高表达。通过核磁共振（NMR）和分子对接，展示了Ref-1与氧化还原特异性小分子抑制剂APX2009的相互作用。该化合物在多种内皮细胞类型中阻断关键的血管生成特征。APX2009在玻璃体内递送时，也改善了小鼠激光诱导的脉络膜新生血管形成（L-CNV）。此外，系统性APX2009减少了小鼠SRN，并在Vldlr(-/-)小鼠模型中下调了Ref-1氧化还原调控的HIF-1alpha靶基因碳酸酐酶9（CA9）的表达。我们的数据验证了Ref-1的氧化还原功能作为眼部血管生成的关键调节因子，表明抑制Ref-1具有治疗nAMD的潜力。
